summary: Tests-first run added local-stub coverage for the existing API operations and an intentional red assertion for the missing ranked-results operation. Swift is unavailable in this container, so the suite could not be executed.

references.result: Upstream OpenAPI document is dynamically served at /api/v1/openapi.json; package dependency and vendoring changes are deferred to the implementation run.
Intentional red assertion: no typed ranked-results operation exists in the hand-written API client.
Current hand-written models remain in place during the tests-only run.
Local URLProtocol stubs cover manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, and judgment upload; execution is blocked because swift is not installed.
Records published-spec deltas and the incomplete ranked-results schema as an upstream endpoint gap.
